action_inputs.description: Tick to add the newly created resource group as a Resource Group option (the platform resource_group_arm parameter) on the Environment this order provisioned into, so it appears in that environment's Resource Group dropdown for VM orders right away. Deleting the resource removes the option again.
action_inputs.label: Add Resource Group to Environment
action_inputs.name: add_to_environment

description: Optional second build step for the Bicep resource-group blueprint: when selected, adds the created resource group's name as a resource_group_arm option on the provisioning Environment (link to a shared CustomFieldValue; environments touched are recorded on the resource for teardown).
name: Add Resource Group to Environment
